events.title: Demo Update and Next Fest
events.summary: Wow time flies.Greetings executives,Sometimes time slips by from you, and you don't end up providing the update cadence you thought you would. This is something I'm committed to working on through a Performance Improvement Plan. Anyway, on to specifics...Demo UpdateThe demo for Hostile Takeover, Inc. has been updated to include full generic controller support, as well as full control remapping! events.title: Greetings and Welcome!
events.summary: Greetings, CEOs!Welcome to the company. Whether you've already played the demo, provided feedback, or just wishlisted and walked away muttering about your own boss — thank you. Truly. A solo dev's most valuable asset is a few people who care, and you're it.For those just joining: Hostile Takeover, Inc. is a satirical top-down action tower defense where you don't just place towers — you play as the CEO, on the office floor.
